column1: # Lab PR 228: the regression thresholds of `cargo xtask perf-compare`
# (docs/validation/PERF_BASELINE.md §5), one line per gated metric of the
#   metric <TAB> threshold, % worse <TAB> floor, in the metric's unit <TAB> why
# Set from its A/A check (three full runs of the same tree on the same guest,
# the baseline and its partners -aa.json and -aa2.json): each threshold is at
# least 10 %, twice the largest move of the metric's median between two of
# the runs and five points above it — for a workload, the move of its
# agent-off reference too, what the host alone moved — rounded up to a
# multiple of 5. The floor is the measurement's resolution (0 for the loss
# counters: from 0 any loss fails). xtask/tests/perf_baseline.rs holds the
# committed runs to these lines. A new baseline (another guest, another
# kernel) comes with its own A/A check and new lines by the same rule.
